name: Vertice Bass
author: NucleoOS
description: Arcade bass fishing tournament in 3D: drive the boat, cast, work the lure, set the hook and fight the fish against the clock. Six lakes, ten species, four lures, weather and time of day, a soundtrack and a top-10 record wall with your initials.

descriptions.en: Arcade bass fishing tournament in 3D: drive the boat, cast, work the lure, set the hook and fight the fish against the clock. Six lakes, ten species, four lures, weather and time of day, a soundtrack and a top-10 record wall with your initials.
descriptions.it: Torneo di pesca arcade in 3D: guida la barca, lancia, lavora l'esca, ferra e combatti il pesce contro il tempo. Sei laghi, dieci specie, quattro esche, meteo e ora del giorno, colonna sonora e la bacheca dei dieci pesci piu grossi con le tue iniziali.
